mafia.name: Mafia
mafia.desc: Vanilla mafia, shares the factional kill.

cop.name: Cop
cop.desc: Each night, check a player and learn their alignment.

rolecop.name: Rolecop
rolecop.desc: Each night, learn the target's exact role.

parity-cop.name: Parity Cop
parity-cop.desc: Learn if the target is the same or different alignment to the previous check. Optional n0 seed.

neapolitan.name: Neapolitan
neapolitan.desc: Learn whether the target is vanilla town or not.

jailkeeper.name: Jailkeeper
jailkeeper.desc: Roleblock and protect the target for the night.

medic.name: Doctor
medic.desc: Protect the target from one kill. May repeat the target.

nerfed-medic.name: Nerfed Medic
nerfed-medic.desc: Protect from one kill. No self, no repeat on consecutive nights.

bodyguard.name: Bodyguard
bodyguard.desc: Redirect kills aimed at the target onto yourself.

bulletproof.name: Bulletproof Townie
bulletproof.desc: Absorb a kill. Reflexive, cannot be roleblocked.

roleblocker.name: Roleblocker
roleblocker.desc: Block the target's action for the night.

mortician.name: Mortician
mortician.desc: Learn the alignment or role of a dead player.

mason.name: Mason
mason.desc: Shares a confirmed-town chat. The app only names the masons; the mod runs the chat.

lover.name: Lover
lover.desc: When one lover dies, the partner dies of lovesickness.

heartbreaker.name: Heartbreaker
heartbreaker.desc: On the heartbreaker's death, the last visited player dies.

joat.name: Jack of All Trades
joat.desc: One action per night from a fixed pool, each usable once.

strongman.name: Strongman
strongman.desc: The factional kill cannot be saved.

fruit-vendor.name: Fruit Vendor
fruit-vendor.desc: Send the target a fruit, appearing as a visit with no other effect.

commuter.name: Commuter
commuter.desc: Leave town for the night, untargetable while away.

universal-backup.name: Universal Backup
universal-backup.desc: Inherit the first town power role that dies.

neighbourizer.name: Neighbourizer
neighbourizer.desc: Put players into a neighbour chat. The app names them; the mod runs the chat.

werewolf.name: Werewolf
werewolf.desc: Wolf faction. A lone wolf plays as a serial killer.

gunsmith.name: Gunsmith
gunsmith.desc: Hand the target a gun for the next day.

champion.name: Champion
champion.desc: Immune if alive at a final three.

poisoner.name: Poisoner
poisoner.desc: Poison the target; they die at end of day unless healed.

poison-healer.name: Poison Healer
poison-healer.desc: Cure a poisoned player during the day.

silencer.name: Silencer
silencer.desc: Silence the target for the next day.

dreamer.name: Dreamer
dreamer.desc: Dream of one town name or three names including one mafia.

sorcerer.name: Sorcerer
sorcerer.desc: Each night, learn whether the target is the Cop. Reads as town to investigation.

parity-champion.name: Parity Champion
parity-champion.desc: Town wins if the mafia only reach parity while the Champion lives.

don.name: Don
don.desc: Vanilla mafia, shares the factional kill. If exiled on day 1, the mafia lose and the game ends.

smart.name: Smart
smart.desc: Kill only lands on mafia; town survives.

vengeful.name: Vengeful
vengeful.desc: On death, kill a chosen player.

stupid.name: Stupid
stupid.desc: Kill only lands on town; a mafia target survives.

gun.name: Gun
gun.desc: A day shot that expires at end of day if unused.

poison.name: Poison
poison.desc: Kills at end of day unless healed.
